scope: Original finite M14/N512 true-DN equations and W14 coordinates, with explicit one-statement LU-lifetime Newton identity; no closed-surface or exact-limit conclusion and no assumed memory improvement.

chart.scope: Frozen positive reference shape; use clamped C2 cubic spline and quintic cutoff x>.75. Same chart at every angular/radial refinement.

runtime_newton_gate: Before first BVP, require original installed f6 Newton, explicitly select the separately bound one-statement LU-lifetime variant and preserve the exact original STATS object; every BVP records/checks the selected identity before and after. Pure preparation installs nothing.
physical_BC_scope: The weighted callable checks inner affine-DN physical-coordinate BC; the unchanged actual outer checks pay the nonlinear BC.

excluded_unused_dependency_cli_entries.scope: Unused dependency CLI entry in the actual true-selector call graph; whole source remains bound.
